title: VENSUKO Launcher 0.16.5 - Achievements & Playtime
notes:
VENSUKO Launcher 0.16.5 - Achievements & Playtime

- Achievements now appear as uniform VENSUKO notifications at the lower-right corner of the screen, delivered by the Launcher rather than by each game.
- DropDash forwards its unlock events through the secure launcher bridge while its in-game achievements browser stays available.
- Show total account playtime consistently in the profile and game detail page, with the current device's local playtime identified separately.
- Synchronize only new, account-attributable native playtime with retry-safe per-installation baselines; preserve all older account and local totals.
- Keep the existing library and preferences cloud-sync gate disabled; no changes to login, gameplay, achievements, friends, downloads or existing saves.
- Support macOS achievement notifications with a compatible dark window without enabling private Apple APIs.
